dct_description_sm: Digital elevation models (DEMs) for the surface and bedrock topography of the Belcher Glacier have been developed using SPOT5 HRS and Landsat 7 ETM+ images, bathymetric information, and airborne and surface-based ground penetrating radar soundings with coincident GPS surface elevation records. An ice thickness map has also been produced from the DEMs. These will be used in mass balance studies, ice dynamics modelling, and hydrologic modelling. Additional information can be found at the following link:  http://people.uleth.ca/~sarah.boon/IPY_page/dems.html
dct_title_s: Belcher Glacier surface and bedrock digital elevation models and ice thickness map
